title: Ravina bar Yirmeyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.50b.11), where Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi raised an objection to him. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim deletes “bar Yirmeyah” and calls the Gilyon HaShas proposal to read Rabbah bar Yirmeyah a scribal error.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Hebrew, Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi addresses Ravina bar Yirmeyah. The [earlier passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.50b.3) names Rabbah bar Yirmeyah, whom the Davidson translation also makes the subject of Rav Sama’s question. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3149&lang=en) records the proposed Rabbah reading for the addressee, which Hyman rejects.
